label: the CBAM registry
jurisdiction: European Union and its Member States (as referred to in W)
device_identity_evidence: Singled out by name: 'the CBAM registry' (a CBAM registry of authorised CBAM declarants in the form of a standardised electronic database; separate section for third-country operators and installations, A14(3))
device_function_evidence: Operator: the Commission (A14(1), A14(6)); governing rules: contents of accounts (A14(2)), confidentiality and public access (A14(4)), controls (A15), account rules (A16); bounded function: registering declarants, operators and installations and the certificates of each declarant
evidence_span: The Commission shall establish a CBAM registry of authorised CBAM declarants in the form of a standardised electronic database

label: the common central platform for the sale and repurchase of CBAM certificates
jurisdiction: European Union and its Member States (as referred to in W)
device_identity_evidence: Singled out by name: 'the common central platform' (A20(1)-(3))
device_function_evidence: Operator: the Commission, which establishes and manages it (A20(2)); bounded function: sale (A20(1)), repurchase (A23(1) second subparagraph) and transfer of transaction information to the CBAM registry (A20(3)); access for the Commission and competent authorities (A20(2) second subparagraph)
evidence_span: The Commission shall establish and manage the common central platform following a joint procurement procedure between the Commission and the Member States
